6-14-24
Cliam opened for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. Police and witnesses confirm the
claimant was in the vehicle at the time. The driver is named on the policy, and nothing suggests the damage
happened before coverage began.
7-17-24
Photos of the vehicle show damage that matches the described impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
7-28-24
Claimant reports neck and back strain consisetnt with the force of the collision. The injury pattern fits the kind of
impact described. No earlier injury to the same body areas is known from prior records.
9-4-24
Photos confirm some details of the scene, but no independent witnesses have come forward. Claimant has given the
same account of events in every conversation so far.
9-10-24
Treatment has grown to many times the usual amount for this type of injury, with near-daily visits. New body areas
were added to the treatment plan several weeks after the crash. Requested additional records from the treating
providers.
10-10-24
Reviewed the file with the claim team. The treatment pattern and timing will be evaluated against the injury
description and the medical records before any settlement discussion with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
